content: Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
sourceWork: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of simplicity and truth. Across his life and work, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
